arkivar.hjelp.ingress: About the program and what it is meant for.
arkivar.hjelp.navn.tekst: Ark-Ivar is a character who appeared on every case folder cover at Jernbaneverket, the Norwegian National Rail Administration. That is where I had my first civilian job in day-to-day records creation, from spring to autumn 2005. So the name is not inspired by a former National Archivist of Norway.
arkivar.hjelp.om.formaal: The purpose of the program is to give students of records management at university colleges and universities practice in how Noark systems work, so that they are better prepared for their placements. The program does not have the functionality needed for real archiving. It is only a simulation of a fictional system based on the Noark standard.
arkivar.hjelp.om.kontakt: Magne Haagen Grøtting. Contact details are available from the Norwegian directory service 1881.
arkivar.hjelp.om.realisme: The functionality in Ark-Ivar is meant to be realistic compared with commercial Noark systems. It is also designed to follow best practice for universal design, user experience and interface design. In some cases this may result in functionality that looks like a copy of existing systems. I want to stress that this is not an alternative to those systems, but a simulation. If you still think something should be changed, please get in touch.

arkivar.struktur.arkivnokkel.henvisning: The class is not used for files in the case archive. See the series:
arkivar.struktur.arkivnokkel.om: The classification scheme is used in the case archive. It is fictional, made for Sirevåg kommune, and builds on the Norwegian central government’s common scheme (statens fellesnøkkel): classes 0, 1 and 2 cover the municipality’s own administration (organisation and administration, finance, positions and staff) and follow the common scheme, while 3–8 are the municipality’s service areas. On every level 0 means “general” and 9 means “other”. A file is placed on the lowest level: the group (three digits), or the main group (two digits) when it is not divided further. Class 9 is unused.

arkivar.struktur.statuskoder.om: The status codes in Noark 5 show how far a case, a journal entry and a document file have come. The whole code list is shown here, including the codes the training archive does not set itself.
